#include <iostream>
#include <string>

std::string process_string(std::string s) {
    size_t pos = s.find("at");
    if (pos != std::string::npos) {
        s.replace(pos, 2, "@");
    }
    if (!s.empty() && s[0] == '@') {
        s = "at" + s.substr(1);
        size_t pos2 = s.find("at");
        if (pos2 != std::string::npos && pos2 != 0) {
            s.replace(pos2, 2, "@");
        }
    }
    if (s.find("dot") != std::string::npos) {
        size_t start_pos = 0;
        while ((start_pos = s.find("dot", start_pos)) != std::string::npos) {
            s.replace(start_pos, 3, ".");
            start_pos += 1;
        }
        if (!s.empty() && s[0] == '.') {
            s.replace(0, 1, "dot");
        }
        if (!s.empty() && s.back() == '.') {
            s.pop_back();
            s += "dot";
        }
    }
    return s;
}

int main() {
    std::string input_str;
    std::getline(std::cin, input_str);
    std::string result = process_string(input_str);
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
